name: Siren Island: Pearlheart
source:
As the crown prince of Gaius, you’ve always lived in luxury—until you flee an arranged marriage and end up shipwrecked on a mysterious island. Now you face an ultimatum: marry a mermaid, or suffer dire consequences.

Join a seductive queen, a fierce warrior, and your kind-hearted friend as you unravel the ocean’s secrets. Battle ruthless hunters, awaken hidden powers, and navigate the turbulent tides of love. Will you save the mermaid kingdom and find your own happiness, or be swept away by fate?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.mermaidsuccubus]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
身为盖乌斯王国的王储，你自幼便过着锦衣玉食的生活——直到你为逃避政治联姻出海，因海难流落到一座神秘岛屿。如今你面临着一道最后通牒：迎娶一位人鱼，否则就要承受可怕的后果。

与妩媚迷人的女王、英勇无畏的战士，以及善良温柔的挚友并肩同行，一同揭开大海深处的秘密。迎战冷酷残忍的猎人，唤醒潜藏的力量，在汹涌澎湃的爱之浪潮中寻找方向。你能否拯救人鱼王国并觅得属于自己的幸福，还是会被命运的洪流吞没？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.mermaidsuccubus]Google Play[/url]]
